summary: C2 compiler crash (SIGSEGV in PhaseIdealLoop::build_loop_late_post_work): a C2 load can bypass the subtype check that guarantees its base object type; seen in production on JDK 21.0.1 (e.g. Elasticsearch CI).
fix: Update to JDK 21.0.2 or newer (fix backported to 21.0.2 as JDK-8319226); as a stopgap, disable C2 with -XX:TieredStopAtLevel=1.

summary: JVM crash (SIGSEGV at ClassListParser::resolve_indy_impl) during -Xshare:dump CDS archive creation on JDK 21.0.5-21.0.8.
fix: Update to JDK 21.0.9 or newer (backport JDK-8366234), or re-run without -Xshare:dump.

summary: C2 compiler crash (SIGSEGV in LShiftLNode::Ideal due to an unexpected dead node); reported on JDK 17.0.15 and 11.0.27 with ECJ-compiled bytecode.
fix: Update to JDK 17.0.19 or newer (backport JDK-8373336).

summary: C2 compiler SIGSEGV in Compile::final_graph_reshaping_walk while compiling Netty's ReferenceCountUpdater::retryRelease0 on JDK 25.0.1.
fix: Update to JDK 25.0.2 or newer (no crash confirmed since 25.0.2+9, see JDK-8375984); as a stopgap, exclude the method with -XX:CompileCommand=exclude,io/netty/util/internal/ReferenceCountUpdater.retryRelease0.
